rules_applied: Removed insignificant whitespace.
Sorted object member names recursively by UTF-16 code-unit order, not locale order: "C" (U+0043), "a" (U+0061), "b" (U+0062).
Serialized integer numbers without extra whitespace or formatting changes.
Removed insignificant whitespace.
Sorted every object recursively by UTF-16 code-unit order, including objects nested inside arrays.
Sorted outer keys as "a" before "z"; sorted the first array object's keys as "x" before "y".
Preserved array element order.
Serialized true and null as lowercase JSON literals.
Sorted keys by UTF-16 code-unit order: "n1", "n2", "n3", "n4", "n5", "n6".
Applied ECMAScript-compatible IEEE 754 double serialization required by JCS.
n1: 1e21 serializes as "1e+21"; positive exponent signs are included.
n2: 1e-7 serializes as "1e-7".
n3: 0.000001 serializes in decimal notation because the decimal-form threshold includes 1e-6.
n4: 100000000000000000000 serializes in decimal notation because it is below 1e21.
n5: negative zero serializes as "0".
n6: the parsed IEEE 754 double is rendered using the shortest round-trippable representation: "333333333.3333333".
Removed insignificant whitespace.
Sorted member names by UTF-16 code-unit order: "$" (U+0024), "aa" beginning with "a" (U+0061), "ü" (U+00FC), "€" (U+20AC).
Emitted non-control Unicode characters directly as UTF-8 rather than escaping them.
Keys were already in UTF-16 code-unit sort order: "s1", "s2", "s3", "s4", "s5".
Escaped newline as "\n".
Escaped horizontal tab as "\t".
Escaped quotation mark as "\"".
Emitted "é" directly as UTF-8; JCS does not require escaping non-control Unicode characters.
Preserved the two trailing U+0020 space characters in s5 without escaping.

weakest_point: Case 3: the byte-exact result depends on parsing n6 as an IEEE 754 binary64 value and applying ECMAScript's shortest round-trippable number serialization; the expected rendering is 333333333.3333333.
